people.name: Chuck Panozzo
people.extract: Charles Salvatore "Chuck" Panozzo is an American musician best known as a co-founder of the rock band Styx. He is currently a part-time bass player in the band, sharing bass duties with Terry Gowan. Panozzo is living with HIV, which played a role in limiting his full-time participation.
highlights: Co-founder of the rock band Styx

people.name: Trevon Diggs
people.extract: Trevon De'Sean Diggs is an American professional football cornerback for the Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide and was selected by the Dallas Cowboys in the second round of the 2020 NFL draft. He is the younger brother of professional wide receiver, Stefon Diggs.
highlights: Professional football cornerback for the Seattle Seahawks
Played college football for Alabama Crimson Tide
Selected by Dallas Cowboys in 2020 NFL draft

people.name: Khabib Nurmagomedov
people.extract: Khabib Abdulmanapovich Nurmagomedov is a Russian former professional mixed martial artist who competed in the Lightweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). He was the longest-reigning UFC Lightweight Champion ever, having held the title from April 2018 to March 2021. With 29 wins and no losses, he retired with an undefeated record. Nurmagomedov is widely considered to be among the greatest mixed martial artists of all time, and was inducted into the UFC Hall of Fame on June 30, 2022.
highlights: Retired with an undefeated record of 29 wins
Inducted into the UFC Hall of Fame
